d:
A woman goes to work.
Chloe Cho is a young Korean-American woman working as an engineer in a tech company in Silicon Valley. Her office is highly competitive and she works with mostly men, though there is another Asian-American woman, Angela, who works there as well and whom Chloe is often mixed up with.
Angela goes away, and Chloe makes inroads at the office and makes herself comfortable at Angela’s apartment, even wearing her clothes and following her routines. But when Angela’s mother makes an unexpected visit, Chloe’s ambitions are threatened, and her illusions begin to unravel.
